prompt:
Build a personal replacement for Taskade in an empty repository, focusing on hierarchical task management and integrated AI assistants.
Use Tauri 2, React, TypeScript, SQLite, and desktop notifications; do not offer alternative stacks.
The core loop is: capture tasks and notes in an outliner format, organize them into projects, run simple local AI agents against the outlines to brainstorm or summarize, and work from a focused daily view.
Make the first run work locally with one documented command. Store all user data locally by default and make export straightforward.
Put secrets in .env, ship .env.example, and never commit credentials.
Create a flexible outliner UI where every bullet point can be a note, a checkbox, a due date, or a sub-item, supporting infinite nesting.
Create inbox, today, upcoming, and completed views with fast keyboard capture and shortcut-driven navigation (indent/outdent).
Support projects, tags, due dates, start dates, priorities, notes, and local file attachments.
Integrate a basic "Agent" feature: a UI sidebar where a configured LLM (via API or local endpoint) can read the current project outline and generate new sub-tasks, summarize the project, or suggest next steps.
Implement robust daily and weekly recurring rules. Add a focus view with one active task, a pomodoro timer, and optional desktop notification.
Export and import a documented JSON or Markdown outline format.
Include clear empty, loading, success, and recoverable error states.
Write focused tests for the outliner tree data transformations and one end-to-end happy path.
Create a README with setup, architecture, permissions, and backup steps.
Do not add accounts, billing, telemetry, analytics, or a hosted control plane.
Deliberately leave out real-time multiplayer cursor tracking, native mind-map rendering, and cross-platform mobile apps.
Finish by running the tests and listing the exact commands used.
